stations.title: Dorrit
stations.note: A customer is on the phone.

stations.title: Pickup shelf
stations.text: Read through by eye, one name at a time.

captions: A customer rings Dorrit to ask whether Oona Pruett's clock is ready to collect.
She reads the pickup shelf by eye while the customer waits on the line.
You write functions that read a list, change one, and hand a new one back.
Now the answer comes at once, and new arrivals join the shelf in order.
Whole lists move between functions now. Next, Kasimir counts his parts by name.
